desc: TITAN is RIX's first thermal rangefinding monocular with free integrated ballistic calculation, making it a powerful spotting tool for snipers. Using the RIX+ app, you can preset environmental factors and firearm parameters. Once the rangefinder measures distance, TITAN calculates ballistic deviation and displays it below the range value. Even if you're not using a RIX scope, as long as you know your MOA and mil values, TITAN will assist in achieving greater shot precision.
